name: Nigrescent-Psalter
description: Rock deserts and sand seas take turns under a sky like hammered brass. Between dust events the wind redraws massive canyon systems, patient as erosion itself.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
For traders, solar potential and rare flora alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
